dogecoin.text: @dogecoin being the 'good guy coin' sets us apart as an actual feature and provides a friendly on-ramp to crypto that many others have no interest in providing. With stress in recent developments comes toxicity. Let's not lose our best feature, please - be good to eachother.

@coindesk sometimes the community is the advantage, even if it isn't technical. But I don't expect you guys to be anything but too blind to see that. @dogecoin continues to bring new people into crypto - it's a feature not a bug. But I realize we're easy to kick around.

@martez20091 Friends who plan to live for hundreds of years? You do realize that bitcoin and eth are adding *far* more inflationary value in fiat equivalent than dogecoin is every day, right? Bitcoin will be doing this for the next 140 yrs. As far as max yearly cap - there already is one.

@DogeShazmon Just rich kids out there claiming to be "CEO of Dogecoin" -- if you see the "article" you'll understand, but I don't want to give this guy free notoriety. Long story short, Dogecoin is not run by some rich kid from Monaco, and no partnership with shitcoins have happened.
